blocks: 0.05-degree longitude/latitude, integer-multiple origin, native pixels assigned by center; all blocks retained in CSV
eligibility: At least 1,000 GHSL population units and 5 square kilometers in primary domain; fixed before extracting rankings
interpretation: Descriptive ranking changes across selected samples; nested224 is a comparator, not truth or evidence of better measurement priorities. Spatial blocks are not treated as independent replicates.
